mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, prompting Federal Reserve rate cuts that boost equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains above 4.5%, persistent monetary policy restrictiveness causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) and high housing starts (HOUST above 1400 thousand units) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 > 2.0 and HOUST > 1400 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS) restricts credit availability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly and UNRATE below 3.5%) fuels wage inflation, prompting aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
